Getting here

Chmelnice, Vranov reservoir.

By car

Enter the GPS coordinates 48.9328522N, 15.7103475E into your satnav. The last few kilometres run through Oslnovice down to the reservoir and the Chmelnice settlement. Parking is free for 10 cars for your whole stay: 6 in the car park right opposite the complex (just across the road), 2 below the terrace along the road and 2 in front of apartment no. 1. The spaces below the terrace and in front of apartment no. 1 have an EV wallbox; charging is billed with the electricity used.

Camping and caravan parking are not allowed around the complex.

On arrival

In winter the access road can be difficult. Please call us the day before arrival on +420 775 704 669. We'll tell you what the road is like and how best to get here.

Check-in is from 15:00. You enter the apartment with a PIN code we send you before arrival. A ramp without steps leads into the complex, to the pool and onto the terrace.

By public transport

Chmelnice is off the main routes, so we recommend coming by car. For larger groups we can help you book a coach.
